died.name: Virgil
died.last_words: Death twitches my ear. 'Live,' he says. 'I am coming.'

died.name: Edward II of England
died.cause: The English king was rumoured to have been murdered after being deposed and imprisoned by his wife Isabella and her lover Roger Mortimer, by having a horn pushed into his anus through which a red-hot iron was inserted, burning out his internal organs without marking his body. However, there is no real academic consensus on the manner of Edward II's death, and it has been plausibly argued that the story is propaganda.

died.name: Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor
died.last_words: Now, Lord, I go! Ay, Jesus!

died.name: James Gardiner
died.cause: to a Jacobite officer after being mortally wounded at the Battle of Prestonpans
died.last_words: You are fighting for an earthly crown; I am going to receive a heavenly one.

died.name: François Séverin Marceau
died.desc: French general of the Revolutionary Wars
died.cause: to General Jean-Baptiste Jourdan when mortally wounded at the Battle of Limburg (1796)
died.last_words: General, why do you shed tears? I am happy to die for my country.

died.name: Walter Scott
died.last_words: I have written nothing which on my deathbed I should wish blotted.

born.name: Girolamo Savonarola
born.cause: when asked before his execution if he was resigned to death
born.last_words: My Lord died innocent of all crimes, for my sins; and shall not I willingly give my soul for the love of Him.

born.name: Maurice Barrymore
born.last_words: Our trade falls heavily upon these feeble folk.

born.name: Sergei Yesenin
born.cause: in his final poem before allegedly taking his own life
born.last_words: Goodbye, my friend, goodbye. My dear, you are in my heart. Predestined separation promises a future meeting.
